summary: Backend-only testing of the new batch (10 event types, 21 templates, ornament_set, section toggles, wish->RSVP cascade, Xendit ready-for-keys mock paths). Added /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (31 new tests) and ran the full suite: 69/69 passed (38 pre-existing regression tests all still green). Verified: GET /api/event-types returns exactly 10 keys in the requested order; GET /api/templates returns 21 unique templates covering all 10 categories with valid ornament/theme/cover and per-category filters non-empty; GET /api/payment/config == {provider:'xendit', mode:'mocked'}; POST /api/events for engagement/khitanan/graduation/anniversary/baby_shower/syukuran/corporate return type-appropriate default_config (engagement bride/groom + show_love_story=false, graduation graduate_name/degree/university, corporate company_name/event_name, baby_shower mother/father/due_date, anniversary years, syukuran host_name/occasion, khitanan child_name/parents), each with ornament_set='floral' and all 11 show_* boolean flags, and all persisted via GET; PATCH /api/events/{id} persists show_gallery=false/show_wishes=false/ornament_set='geometric' and toggles are exposed on the public invitation payload (user_id stripped); wish cascade works for attending (rsvp_updated=true, guest rsvp_status/guest_count=3/notes/responded_at set, /rsvp/summary shows attending=1, headcount=3, pending=2), not_attending cascades with default guest_count=1, guest_count clamped at 20, 'maybe' does NOT cascade (rsvp_updated=false), no guest_slug or unknown guest_slug creates the wish with rsvp_updated=false; mock checkout returns {mocked:true, mode:'mocked', amount_idr:149000, payment_id pay_*, checkout_url /checkout/{payment_id}}; /api/xendit/webhook rejects requests when no callback token is configured; unauthenticated checkout returns 401.

minor.issue: rsvp_updated is derived from update_one().modified_count. If the guest doc already holds identical rsvp values the write is a no-op and the API reports rsvp_updated=false even though the guest matched. Prefer matched_count (responded_at currently masks this most of the time).

config is replaced wholesale (no server-side merge). A partial PATCH such as {config:{show_gallery:false}} silently drops every other config key. Frontend sends the full object so the UI works, but the API contract is fragile for the new per-section toggles.
template_id is not validated against the TEMPLATES list, and event_type is not validated against EVENT_TYPES - an unknown type silently falls back to the generic base config.

action_items: Consider using matched_count for rsvp_updated in submit_wish so an idempotent resubmit is not reported as a failed cascade.
Consider merging config on PATCH (or documenting that clients must send the full config) now that 11 independent section toggles exist.
Validate event_type/template_id on POST /api/events (400 on unknown values) instead of silently using the fallback config.
Split /app/backend/server.py (967 lines) into routers/modules (templates, events, public, payments).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 967 lines and holds templates data, routers, and payment integration in one file - split into modules.

Xendit live path uses the blocking `requests` library inside async endpoints (checkout + payment complete); this blocks the event loop under load. Use httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_executor before enabling real keys.
submit_wish cascade does not verify the guest exists; an invalid guest_slug quietly returns rsvp_updated=false with no signal to the client.
seed_data_creation: Seeded a temporary Mongo user + user_sessions token per test module (deleted in teardown); all created events/guests/wishes prefixed TEST and deleted in fixture teardown.
test_credentials: No passwords - seeded MongoDB session token per /app/memory/test_credentials.md (Authorization: Bearer <session_token>).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite now has 3 files under /app/backend/tests (69 tests, all green): backend_test.py (core CRUD/payment/RSVP), test_wishes_and_config.py (rich wedding config + wishes), test_new_features.py (event types, 21 templates, section toggles, ornament_set, wish->RSVP cascade, mock checkout, webhook auth). Frontend was NOT tested this iteration - /templates gallery, /templates/:id/preview, ornament rendering, Google Maps iframe embed, and the floating music toggle still need UI verification.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. Minor findings are contract-level: modified_count-based rsvp_updated flag, non-merging config PATCH, and missing event_type/template_id validation.
